description: PANEM_U is a motivated team passionate about technology, problem-solving, and innovation. Combining skills in programming, data analysis, design, and digital solutions, we turn challenges into meaningful results. What sets us apart is our strong teamwork, curiosity, and drive to explore new ideas.
summary: Global Planetary Analog Finder helps mission teams shortlist Earth sites for Moon and Mars field tests. Users choose a planetary profile, adjust the importance of each criterion, and compare up to three Earth locations. The pilot ranks 892 land cells using NASA POWER climatology and, for selected Mars profiles, measurements from planetary missions. The atlas explains what drives each score and where the analogy breaks down. Terrain Lab adds satellite imagery, 3D relief, and route planning for closer inspection of a candidate site.
details: The pilot covers four regions and uses NASA POWER climatology from 2001 to 2025. Users can inspect individual criterion scores and change their weights. One example compares a site in the Algerian Sahara with Jezero crater using Perseverance MEDA observations. The atlas helps teams shortlist sites for rover trials and instrument testing. Terrain Lab builds on TerraNova by Team DaRK_MATTER under the Apache 2.0 license.
